messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians could have taken advantage of in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a weekday and is adjacent to a weekend, or a holiday that is observed on a substitute day that creates a three‑day break.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes / Substitute Days |
|---------|---------|--------------------------|
| **Feb 20 – Feb 22** | Family Day (AB, BC, SK, ON) | All four provinces observe Family Day on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday (all provinces & territories) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in every province/territory. |
| **May 22 – May 24** | Victoria Day (all provinces & territories) | Celebrated on the last Monday before May 25. |
| **Jul 3 – Jul 5** | Canada Day substitute (AB, BC, SK, ON, MB, NB, NL, PEI, QC, YT, NT, NU) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, July 1. Most jurisdictions give a substitute day on Monday, July 3. |
| **Sep 4 – Sep 6** | Labour Day (all provinces & territories) | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 9 – Oct 11** | Thanksgiving (all provinces & territories) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 13 – Nov 15** | Remembrance Day substitute (AB, BC, SK, ON, MB, NB, NL, PEI, QC, YT, NT, NU) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, Nov 11. Many jurisdictions observe a substitute day on Monday, Nov 13. |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 27** | Christmas Day (all provinces & territories) | Christmas Day fell on Monday, Dec 25. |
| **Dec 26 – Dec 28** | Boxing Day (AB, BC, SK, ON, MB, NB, NL, PEI, QC, YT, NT, NU) | Boxing Day is a statutory holiday in most provinces/territories. |

### Quick Takeaway

- **Total long weekends (including substitute days):** 10 (if you count substitute days for Canada Day, Remembrance Day, and Boxing Day).
- **If you only count holidays that actually fell on a weekday in 2023:** 7 (Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, Boxing Day).

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app!
